reference: Cockburn & Shu, JCP 141 (1998) 199-224, Part V; Kopriva & Batta, JCP 270 (2014) 550
description: Curvilinear (isoparametric) DG for 2D Euler equations — convergence study on straight and warped meshes. This case verifies that the curvilinear operator achieves design order p+1 on both straight and warped meshes, and that the warped/straight error ratio stays O(1) (curvature does not cost accuracy).

physics.scheme: Strong-form modal DG, tensor-product Legendre basis

evidence_lines.title: Design order — straight mesh
evidence_lines.description: Relative L2 error on straight mesh at p=1,2. Design order p+1, paper tolerance p+1/2.

evidence_lines.title: Design order — warped mesh
evidence_lines.description: Relative L2 error on warped mesh at p=1,2. Same criteria as straight.

evidence_lines.title: Curved-straight equivalence
evidence_lines.description: The warped/straight error ratio should stay O(1), i.e. curvature does not cost accuracy.
evidence_lines.acceptance: warped_error / straight_error < 10 for all mesh/degree combinations
evidence_lines.details: warped/straight error ratios are O(1) across all mesh refinements

evidence_lines.title: Cartesian reference comparison
evidence_lines.description: The curvilinear solution on a warped mesh should match the Cartesian solution on an equivalent mesh.
evidence_lines.details: curvilinear and Cartesian solutions agree to within numerical tolerance
